raw.details:
AI Manthan – 

AI Manthan is a National Level Hackathon aimed at fostering innovation, creativity, and problem-solving skills among developers and change-makers. Participants will conceptualize impactful ideas and transform them into working prototypes over two rounds, addressing real-world challenges.

Theme: Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies

AI Manthan 2.0 will be conducted in two rounds.

Round 1: Online PPT Submission

Teams are required to submit a PPT showcasing either:

  • An existing project, or A new project idea
  • PPT Template : https://canva.link/i38rancxrquur0f

The submission will be screened based on the team's technical ability, creativity, and problem-solving approach.

After the screening process, the Top teams will be shortlisted for the final round.

Round 2: 24-Hour Offline Hackathon

The shortlisted teams will participate in the final 24-hour offline hackathon at Acropolis Institute of Technology and Research, Indore.

Problem Statements for round 2 will be revealed after Round 1 Results.

Final Round Registration Fee -  ₹1200 per team qualifying to Round 2.

Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000+

  • Winner: ₹50,000
  • 1st Runner-up: ₹25,000
  • 2nd Runner-up: ₹10,000
  • 10 Special Recognition: ₹1,500 per team

Note : Prize money will be credited within 30 days after the hackathon ends.

Domains:

  • AI for Healthcare & Medical Services
  • AI for Women Safety (Safety & Security)
  • AI for Smart Governance
  • AI for Agriculture
  • AI for Rural Education (Education & Learning)
  • AI for Disaster Management
  • AI for Smart Cities (Urban Development & Infrastructure)
  • AI for Clean India (Swachh Bharat Initiative)
  • AI for Career Development
  • AI for Tourism
  • AI for Food Redistribution
  • AI for Urban Monitoring

Hackathon Rules and Guidelines:

  • Team Size: Your Team may have Min.1 and Max. 4 members
  • Equipment: Teams must bring their own laptops and required hardware.
  • Premises Policy: Leaving the venue without prior permission will lead to disqualification.
  • Accommodation: Common lodging arrangements; no separate rooms provided.
  • Ethics: Plagiarism, unethical practices, or use of unauthorized resources will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Payment Policy: No refunds after registration.
  • Second Round Fee: ₹1200 per team qualifying to Round 2.

Event Details:

  • Date: 31 OCT & 1 NOV 2026
  • Location: Acropolis Institute of Technology and Research (AITR), Bypass Road, Square, Mangliya Sadak, Indore, Madhya Pradesh
  • Platform: Any coding platform is allowed within the premises (e.g., VSCode, Sublime, GitHub)

Note : The link for the problem statements and the PPT format will be shared soon.

Additional Information:

  • Participants must arrange their own travel.
  • Free stay with locker, breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
  • Lockers will be provided, but you have to bring your own locks.
  • Registration fees are non-refundable under any circumstances
